_DOCTRINE: Report mechanics, never make the call. check-noconnect exit 0 before import. A null fact DELETES its sentence. No drift-prone value in a title, heading or excerpt.
_WHY: S-transit is open: the corpus covers WHICH airlines and airports and says 'check which airport your flight uses', but never who carries a missed connection, what a through-ticket obliges, or what a failed internal leg does to a fixed international return. These five report the components.
_DEPTH_TARGET: Batches 18 and 19 together take S-transit from 1,662 to ~7,000 dedicated words, because a 2,000-word book chapter needs more corpus than the old 3,000 floor.

articles.title: Through-Tickets and Separate Tickets on a Turkey Trip
reports: what a through-ticket is and what it obliges the carrier to do when a leg fails
what changes when two legs are bought separately, including who owns a missed connection
baggage: when it is checked through and when it must be reclaimed and re-checked
how a codeshare or interline agreement differs from two bookings on the same airline
how to tell which kind you actually hold from the confirmation
articles.must_not_say: how much connection time to leave, or which way to book — the margin rule is the book's

articles.title: Istanbul's Two Airports and the Transfer Between Them
reports: where IST and SAW sit relative to the city and to each other
the transfer options between them, journey times and what they cost
that this transfer exists in no airline system — it is landside, on the passenger
which carriers and route types typically use which airport
how a same-day itinerary using both airports actually plays out
articles.must_not_say: how many hours to allow between flights at different airports

articles.title: What Turkish Airlines Owe You When a Domestic Flight Fails
reports: the Turkish civil-aviation passenger-rights regulation and what it covers
the duty of care thresholds: meals, communication, accommodation
rebooking versus refund, and who chooses
compensation levels by distance band, and the extraordinary-circumstances exception
how a claim is made and to whom
articles.must_not_say: whether to claim, or that insurance is the answer

articles.title: Connecting Through Istanbul Airport
reports: the published minimum connection times at IST, by connection type
the international-to-domestic path: passport control, baggage, terminal movement
transit without entering Turkey, and when that is and isn't possible
what a domestic-to-international connection requires instead
the airport's scale and what that means for walking time

articles.title: When a Bus or Train Beats a Flight in Turkey
reports: the high-speed rail network's actual routes and journey times
intercity coach journey times on the corridors travelers use
door-to-door comparison components: transfer time, check-in, city-centre arrival
which corridors have no flight at all
booking and ticketing mechanics for rail and coach
articles.must_not_say: which mode to choose on any given route
